messages:
elaine: Noticed a repeating cluster across Feb024 PMs: cache eviction storms and uneven batch routing. Creating a short action thread to assign owners and get short ETAs.

tom: I can take cache eviction telemetry and basic dashboarding. Will track hit/miss by model and eviction spikes.

diego: Routing mismatch is my lane. I have a hypothesis: model affinity tags are stale during rollouts causing hot-paths. Will validate with trace sampling.

chen: Ops observation: three PMs lacked an explicit remediation owner; that'll delay fixes. I'll update the template to require owner + due date and add a recurrence flag.

elaine: Minimal tracker (paste into PMs):
- R1 | Owner: tom | ETA: 2024-05-08 | Add eviction spikes metric, dashboard, alert
- R2 | Owner: diego | ETA: 2024-05-05 | Run trace-sampling on recent rollouts, confirm routing-affinity bug
- R3 | Owner: chen | ETA: 2024-05-12 | Template update + retro to assign missing owners
- R4 | Owner: ops-bot | ETA: 2024-04-29 | Run automated recurrence report and post results

tom: I'll open a small PR and wire the dashboard panels today: https://git.internal/redwood/eviction-dash

diego: Plan: enable sampling on 5% of rollout traffic for 72h, correlate tag drift with route spikes. Rollback criteria and thresholds in my doc.

ops-bot: Recurrence report: top patterns last 60d: cache-eviction storms (14%), batch-routing hot-paths (11%), memory regressions after model upgrades (6%). CSV: s3://redwood-ops/recurrence/2024-04-report.csv

chen: I'll add recurrence enum (none/low/med/high) to the PM template and require owner+ETA fields. Posting PR by EOD.

elaine: Let's meet Thursday 11am PT to check R1/R2 progress and confirm canary configs. Please update this thread with links by EOD Wednesday.

tom: Dashboard + PR posted.

diego: Sampling enabled on canary pool, will drop traces here once collected.

chen: Template PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/pm-template. Includes recurrence enum and owner/ETA enforcement.

elaine: Great. Aim to close R1/R2 this sprint. If anyone hits blockers, ping #eng-oncall or @ops-bot for the next recurrence scan.
